summary: The King Is Dead is a lean area-majority game where three medieval factions vie for the throne while you secretly want a particular faction (not necessarily your own pieces) to end up on top. Hidden agendas and a shrinking map create a tense, bluffy negotiation-adjacent experience in a short playtime.
praised: clever hidden-goal twist on area control
short playtime for the depth offered
criticised: can feel swingy or kingmaker-y with certain player counts

scoring.why: winning depends on which faction ends up dominant relative to your secret allegiance, not a points total

_name: The King Is Dead: Second Edition
